props.name: optionLabel
props.comment: Column header for the choice column. Default the resource/source label.

props.name: optionText
props.comment: The display path or a formatter for a choice. Default `"name"`.

props.name: optionValue
props.comment: The value path on a choice. Default `"id"`.

props.name: source
props.comment: The FK-array field; supplied ambiently inside a `<ReferenceArrayInput>`.

props.name: translateChoice
props.comment: Translate the choice text through the catalog.
